newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Zaire refugees flee to Tanzania by boat.
newsitem.headline: Zaire refugees flee to Tanzania by boat.

text.p: About 1,700 refugees from Zaire have arrived in the western Tanzanian port of Kigoma after crossing Lake Tanganyika, Tanzanian radio reported on Sunday.
A regional police commander told the radio that the refugees had fled in small boats to escape the fighting in their homeland on Friday. Ten of them had gunshot wounds, he said.
The refugees were being accommodated at a refugee camp in Kigoma town, where they were being assisted by the UN. They reported that many more Zaireans intended fleeing to Tanzania, the radio said.
